title: can, could, be able to
en:
can — ability now, possibility, permission: I can read IFRS reports. Can I use your phone?

could — general ability in the past: I could swim when I was five. Also polite requests: Could you send me the file?

be able to — for forms that can doesn't have: future, present perfect, after another verb: I'll be able to start in May. I haven't been able to call him. I'd like to be able to speak fluently.

One specific success in the past → was / were able to or managed to: The fire spread fast, but everyone was able to leave. (Negative couldn't is always fine.)
ru: can — умею/могу сейчас, разрешение. could — умел в прошлом, вежливая просьба. be able to — для будущего (will be able to), Present Perfect (haven't been able to), после других глаголов. Один конкретный успех в прошлом — was able to / managed to.

boss.situation: Write about your skills: 2 sentences with can, 1 with could (past), 1 with will be able to and 1 with have(n't) been able to.
samples: I can build a risk matrix in Excel.
I can't speak English fluently yet.
When I was a student, I could study all night.
Next year I will be able to give presentations in English.
I haven't been able to finish the course because of work.

qs.q: When I was ten, I ___ play chess very well.
qs.exp: General ability in the past → could.

qs.q: I'm sorry, I ___ come to the meeting tomorrow.
qs.exp: Possibility about the future → can't (or won't be able to).

qs.q: After the course you ___ use the system on your own.
qs.exp: Future ability → will be able to.
qs.ru: Будешь уметь — will be able to.

qs.q: ___ you send me the report, please?
“I will can help you tomorrow” is correct.
qs.exp: No will can → I will be able to help you.

qs.q: “I haven't been able to contact him” is correct.
I'd like ___ (be able to) speak English fluently.
a: to be able to
qs.exp: After another verb → to be able to.
